text:
Alex: Quick sanity check thread — replay harness vs prod for KV prefill + kernel selection parity. Found a p50 token latency bump (~+7%) when running traces without a KV prefill window.

Maria: ugh, that's big. Is that specific to one kernel combo or general? :eyes:

Alex: looks tied to the cuda-optimized attention kernel + continuous-batching heuristics. With kv-prefill disabled the runtime picks a different kernel path early in sequence and we get worse occupancy.

Jia: can you paste the exact replay command you ran? want to reproduce locally.

Alex: sure — this is the minimal repro we used:

```bash
replay-run --trace /mnt/traces/prod/2026-03-10.trace \n  --anonymize --seed 42 --sampling-rate 0.05 \n  --kv-prefill-window 0 \n  --batch-policy continuous --target-qps 150\n```

Alex: note `--kv-prefill-window 0` is the difference vs prod which uses 30s.

perf-bot: perf/regression 2769123475: p50 tokens +7.1% (baseline: 22ms -> 23.6ms), p95 +4.4%. Kernel-change events: 1.3x more fallback-to-generic. See dashboard: https://perf.internal/r/2769

Sam: could anonymization be introducing nondeterminism? we hash ids but maybe timestamps or randomized metadata are leaking in.

Jia: we run deterministic anonymize steps in the pipeline (salted sha256 + fixed seed) — should be fine. The likely culprit is timing/pacing and kv-warmup. If the trace pacing is burstier in replay, batching heuristics choose larger batches which then cause kernel fallback.

Maria: so apples-to-apples checklist:
- match request pacing distribution (use --pacing-histogram)
- match sequence length histogram (--seq-hist)
- match kv-prefill window (default prod = 30s)
- fix RNG seeds for anonymize and sampling
- capture kernel_choice_counts and kv_hit_rate_by_prefix during runs

Jia: adding metrics is key. I'll add `kernel_choice_counts` and `kv_hit_rate_by_prefix` to the replay exporter.

Alex: re-ran with kv-prefill=30s and pacing-hist loaded from prod, perf-bot shows parity: p50 delta now +0.3%. Kernel choice distribution matches within 2%.

perf-bot: perf/check 2769123530: kv-prefill=30s run -> p50 delta +0.3%, fallback rate within 2% of prod. Summary saved to https://perf.internal/r/2769/run/2

Sam: nice. So for the investigation steps: 1) always run kv-prefill=prod value, 2) include pacing hist, 3) capture kernel_choice_counts. Anything else?

Maria: also record `kv_fill_latency` and `kv_eviction_counts` — we saw a small spike in evictions during the warmup in one host which aggravated kernel selection.

Alex: good call. I'm updating the replay README with a short repro template and the checklist. Will push a small helper: `replay-bake --trace ... --kv-prefill 30 --export-metrics kernel_choice_counts,kv_hit_rate_by_prefix`

ops-bot: Scheduled daily smoke run with kv-prefill=30s and full metric export at 03:00 UTC starting 2026-03-19.

Jia: I'll land the metrics export PR today and add a unit test for deterministic anonymize seeds.

Alex: thanks — once CI is green let's run the full 10% sample sweep across kernels and file a perf board ticket if anything drifts. :hammer:

Maria: +1, ping me if the perf board ticket appears and I'll slot it for the weekly runtime sync.

Sam: awesome thread, saved me time reproducing.

Alex: thanks everyone, closing the loop here.
